piezas.titulo: Reading words: Professional communication and meetings
texto: Reading and spelling of professional terminology: «ข้อเสนอ» has «ข้อ» (high-class consonant ข with ้, falling tone) and «เสนอ» (ส นํา น, rising tone). «กำหนดการ» combines «กำหนด» (mid-class consonant ก, low tone on หนด) and «การ» (mid tone). «รับผิดชอบ» has three syllables: «รับ» (high tone), «ผิด» (low tone) and «ชอบ» (falling tone). «ร่วมมือ» has the sign ่ over the low-class consonant ร in «ร่วม» (falling tone) and «มือ» in mid tone. Knowing these terms lets you read meeting minutes and work agreements.

pregunta.texto: Reading comprehension: According to the text, which idea does the sentence «การนำเสนอข้อมูลอย่างกระชับและตรงประเด็นช่วยประหยัดเวลาในที่ประชุม» express?

opciones.texto: Presenting data concisely and directly saves time in working sessions.
opciones.explicacion: Correct: this option translates and accurately interprets the sentence «การนำเสนอข้อมูลอย่างกระชับและตรงประเด็นช่วยประหยัดเวลาในที่ประชุม» from the text.

opciones.texto: The assembly reviews proposals and hears the views of each department.
opciones.explicacion: Incorrect: this is another statement from the passage, not the meaning of the sentence in question.

opciones.texto: Keeping formal minutes confirms the resolutions and commitments agreed.
opciones.explicacion: Incorrect: this option corresponds to another sentence in the reading passage.

pregunta.texto: In the word «รับผิดชอบ» (to be responsible for), what is the tonal structure of its three syllables?

opciones.texto: High tone (รับ) + Low tone (ผิด) + Falling tone (ชอบ)
opciones.explicacion: Correct: a low-class consonant in a short dead syllable (รับ, high), a high-class consonant in a dead syllable (ผิด, low) and a low-class consonant with a long vowel in a dead syllable (ชอบ, falling).
Incorrect: none of the three syllables has a mid tone, as all are dead syllables.
Incorrect: dead syllables do not produce a rising tone without specific marks.
